notes: בֵּין X לְ Y series read pair by pair under rule 26: each written between goes to the בֵּין opening its pair, the לְ standing where the connective stands takes and, later לְ members written bare are unrepresented, and the final and is the waw's.

Apodosis waw before 'ye shall warn' is unrepresented; the purpose waw takes 'that' and the result waw takes the pair 'and so' (rule 55), with 'so' added as the competing reading; הָיָה → 'come' is the copular verb the ASV wrote (rule 20).
